QuestInfo.name: Missing Pieces
QuestInfo.0: #b#p702##k in #b#m010006000##k looks like he hasn't slept. Something of his has gone missing.
QuestInfo.1: Someone has been stealing #b#p702##k's ward scrolls. A man named #b#p437##k buys fairy-made goods. He keeps to a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in #b#m010003000##k.
QuestInfo.2: I found #b#p437##k, a fence who buys goods from the Hollow. He won't say who sells to him.

0.0: Three ward scrolls. Three! I left them on my bench for one night, and now they're gone.
0.1: At first I blamed myself. I always lose things when I don't sleep. But the whole bench was wiped clean. Even my good tongs are gone.
0.2: #b#p701##k heard from a traveler that fairy-made goods are being sold in Kerning City. A man named #b#p437##k buys them.
0.3: They say he keeps to a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in #b#m010003000##k. Could you find him? I need to know who is taking things from the Hollow.

yes.0: Thank you. There's a hidden way up somewhere on those roofs. Be careful. People who buy stolen goods aren't always friendly.

no.0: I understand. But every day we wait, more of the Hollow ends up in Kerning City.

1.0: Welcome, friend. Looking to buy? I have some rare things today. Fairy-made, if you can believe it.
1.1: ...Ah. You're not here to buy. You're here about the scrolls.
1.2: Look, I didn't steal anything. I buy and I sell, that's all. And business has been very good, thanks to the Hollow.
1.3: One day the whole guild will know the name #b#p437##k. But not if I tell every stranger where I get my goods.

npc.0: The buyer is #b#p437##k. He keeps to a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in #b#m010003000##k.
